description: This file defines database entity data classes for a calendar and astrology app, using Room persistence library annotations. It includes entities for calendar events, leaves, and astrology data, each with primary keys and associated fields.

classes.name: CalendarEventEntity
classes.description: Represents a calendar event with fields for ID, date, title, type, description, and last modification timestamp.

classes.name: LeaveEntity
classes.description: Represents a leave entry with fields for ID, date, title, leave type, description, and last modification timestamp.

classes.name: AstrologyEntity
classes.description: Represents astrology data with fields for ID, date, raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, special notes, and last modification timestamp.
